name: Re:amaze
oneLiner: Helpdesk and AI customer service platform for ecommerce and online businesses, with a shared inbox, live chat, bots and multi-brand support (sold as Re:amaze by GoDaddy).
bestFor: Online stores and brands, including food and beverage brands selling online, that run several storefronts on Shopify, BigCommerce or WooCommerce.

updates.text: Intents, which sort incoming messages, now run on AI and need no extra training data.
The AI context used for generated replies and FAQs now also powers response templates, quick replies, appointment and shopper bots, suggested responses and the AI FAQ bot.

features: Shared inbox for email, live chat, social media, SMS and voice
AI Agent (beta) trained on your help content, extended from chat to email and SMS
Order details from Shopify, BigCommerce and WooCommerce inside conversations
Chatbots and Cues (proactive, trigger-based chat messages)
Multiple brands with separate inboxes, help centers and branding in one account

pricing.text: Per-user plans: Basic $29, Pro $49 and Plus $69 per user/month; a Starter plan is $59/month flat for up to 500 responded conversations. Annual billing is discounted. Free trial available.

notes: reamaze.com could not be fetched; prices come from a May 2026 snapshot of the pricing page quoted in third-party guides and should be confirmed on reamaze.com/pricing. Built Bar and Todd Snyder appear as testimonials on Shopify's Re:amaze partner page; the Built Bar '5.6x faster' figure comes only from a third-party listing and was not used. Original's '$29/month for 3 team members' was replaced (pricing is now per user). The AI Agent email/SMS expansion appears to be from 2026 but I couldn't confirm the month, so it isn't dated.
